# AtroUI Docs

> Dark-first React / Next.js catalog on the official shadcn registry. MIT. You own the copied files.
> Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @atroui/home-hero` (any `@atroui/…` item)
> Public namespace `@atroui` — https://ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json — no GitHub token.
> Tailwind CSS v4. Optional Host APIs (`npm i atroui` + BYOK). Site: https://www.atroui.com
> Full catalog dump: https://www.atroui.com/llms-full.txt
> Registry JSON: https://www.atroui.com/r/registry.json
> Repo: https://github.com/atroui/atroui

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://www.atroui.com/docs): First-hour Quick Start — init, add a block, essential commands.
- [Installation](https://www.atroui.com/docs/installation): Prerequisites, init, add, what lands in the repo, troubleshooting.
- [Coming from…](https://www.atroui.com/docs/migrate): Task paths from plain shadcn/ui, npm atroui, or copy-paste kits.
- [Collections](https://www.atroui.com/docs/collections): Job hubs — forms, OG, launch — instead of browsing every block.

## Setup

- [Registry](https://www.atroui.com/docs/registry): How `@atroui/…` copies source into your repo and how names map.
- [Theming](https://www.atroui.com/docs/theming): Dark-first tokens, Merriweather headings + DM Sans UI, opt-in Caveat sketch.
- [Host APIs](https://www.atroui.com/docs/host-api): Forms and AI routes on your keys — BYOK, 503 when missing.

## Kits

- [Brand kit](https://www.atroui.com/docs/brand): Logo mark, wordmark, and brand voice assets.
- [Identity kit](https://www.atroui.com/docs/identity): Site name, SEO, and identity config.
- [Launch workflow](https://www.atroui.com/docs/guides/launch-workflow): Scope a build through OG social cards.

## Reference

- [Glossary](https://www.atroui.com/docs/glossary): Host API, BYOK, registry, and related terms.
- [Compare](https://www.atroui.com/docs/compare): How AtroUI differs from primitives-only / copy-paste kits.
- [Changelog](https://www.atroui.com/docs/changelog): Release notes.

## Catalog

- [Components](https://www.atroui.com/docs/components): Live gallery of Primitives, Blocks, Tools, Headless.
- Catalog JSON: https://www.atroui.com/r/registry.json

### Primitives (highlights)
- @atroui/button, @atroui/card, @atroui/textarea, @atroui/form-select
- @atroui/breadcrumbs, @atroui/prose, @atroui/theme-toggle, @atroui/theme-provider, @atroui/logo
- @atroui/fade-in, @atroui/stagger, @atroui/scroll-progress

### Blocks (highlights)
- @atroui/home-hero, @atroui/site-header, @atroui/site-footer, @atroui/faq
- @atroui/pricing-overview, @atroui/contact-form, @atroui/waitlist-form
- @atroui/og-workspace, @atroui/thumbnail-workspace, @atroui/scope-chat, @atroui/project-planner

## Tools (live rooms)

- [OG workspace](https://www.atroui.com/og): Generate social cards in the browser.
- [Project planner](https://www.atroui.com/planner): Scope a build, hand off to OG.
